Settings.0767.zh-Hans: 闲置半小时后休眠，再次打开时恢复原位置。固定标签页、音频、通话和有输入内容的页面保持活跃。

Settings.0768.zh-Hans: 切换到后台标签页时才加载

Settings.0769.zh-Hans: 通过 ⌘ 单击、鼠标中键或其他应用批量打开的后台链接，会等到切换到对应标签页时才加载。⇧⌘ 单击仍会立即打开。

Settings.0770.en: Search a site from the address field

Settings.0771.zh-Hans: 输入网站名称的开头，如 red 或 yout，再按 Tab，即可在该网站搜索。访问过且支持搜索的网站会加入列表。

Settings.0773.zh-Hans: 每次启动 SearcheXtra 时保留固定标签页，不恢复上次的其他标签页。

Settings.0777.zh-Hans: 在侧边栏中按名称分组。右键点击标签页创建分组，点击组标题展开或收起。

Settings.0779.zh-Hans: 类似 Arc：常用网站固定为方块，保留页面固定为下方列表，其余标签页上方显示“清除”。右键点击标签页可将其固定为列表项。

Settings.0781.en: Show two tabs side by side. Drag a tab onto a page to pair them.
Settings.0781.zh-Hans: 并排显示两个标签页。将标签页拖到页面上即可组合。

Spaces.1033.zh-Hans: {0} — 按 ⌃1–⌃9 或在标签栏上双指{1}滑动切换

Spaces.1043.zh-Hans: 使用设置中的下载文件夹

Welcome.1146.zh-Hans: 简洁轻巧的浏览器。仅约 4 MB，使用 Mac 内置引擎，让你专注于网页。

Welcome.1185.zh-Hans: 密码：{0} 设置了主密码，请导出密码后导入 CSV 文件

WhatsNew.1210.zh-Hans: 在页面上方显示书签栏。

WhatsNew.1211.en: Float the video when you switch apps
WhatsNew.1211.zh-Hans: 切换应用时自动开启画中画

WhatsNew.1212.en: A playing video follows you out into a small window.
WhatsNew.1212.zh-Hans: 切换应用时，正在播放的视频会进入画中画窗口。

WhatsNew.1214.en: Smoother scrolling and animations on screens that can. Uses more battery.
WhatsNew.1214.zh-Hans: 在支持的屏幕上获得更流畅的滚动和动画，但会增加耗电。

WhatsNew.1216.en: Click the wheel, then move the mouse to scroll, as on Windows.
WhatsNew.1216.zh-Hans: 单击滚轮后移动鼠标即可滚动，操作与 Windows 类似。

WhatsNew.1218.en: Several windows, and a lot to discover. Most of what's new is off until you turn it on, and the card after the update offers it.
WhatsNew.1218.zh-Hans: 支持多窗口并新增多项功能。多数新功能默认关闭，可通过更新后的提示卡启用。

WhatsNew.1219.en: Several windows. ⌘N opens one with its own tabs; drag a tab out of the row, or use Move to Window in its menu, and it moves with its page as it is. Pinned tabs are the same in every window.
WhatsNew.1219.zh-Hans: 支持多窗口。⌘N 打开独立窗口；将标签页拖出标签栏，或在菜单中选择“移至窗口”，即可连同页面一起移动。所有窗口共享固定标签页。

WhatsNew.1220.en: Tab groups, and a sidebar on the right.
WhatsNew.1220.zh-Hans: 新增标签页分组和右侧侧边栏。

WhatsNew.1221.en: ⌃Tab shows your recent tabs as pictures, the last one first: a quick ⌃Tab goes back to the tab you were on.
WhatsNew.1221.zh-Hans: ⌃Tab 以缩略图显示最近使用的标签页，最近使用的排在前面；快速按 ⌃Tab 可返回上一个标签页。

WhatsNew.1222.en: Your own keyboard shortcuts, in Settings › Shortcuts.
WhatsNew.1222.zh-Hans: 可在“设置 › 快捷键”中自定义快捷键。

WhatsNew.1223.en: Downloads show while they happen: a small circle fills beside the other buttons, and the Finder and the Dock show the progress too. The button can stay there for good.
WhatsNew.1223.zh-Hans: 下载时在按钮旁显示圆形进度，访达和程序坞也会显示进度。下载按钮可设置为始终显示。

WhatsNew.1224.en: Bring things over from Firefox, Zen, Helium, Comet, Opera, Chrome's other channels and Arc, its spaces and pinned tabs included, or from an exported file.
WhatsNew.1224.zh-Hans: 支持从 Firefox、Zen、Helium、Comet、Opera、Chrome 的其他版本及 Arc 导入数据，包括 Arc 的空间和固定标签页，也可导入已导出的文件。

WhatsNew.1225.en: Site shortcuts: a word of your own before a search sends it to that site, like yt cats to YouTube.
WhatsNew.1225.zh-Hans: 网站搜索快捷词：在搜索前加上自定义词即可搜索指定网站，例如用 yt cats 搜索 YouTube。

WhatsNew.1226.en: Bookmarks in the order you choose, folders of your own, and a card to name a bookmark as you add it.
WhatsNew.1226.zh-Hans: 支持书签排序、自建文件夹，添加书签时可在卡片中命名。

WhatsNew.1227.en: Videos can wait for a click, and every site can start at a zoom of your choice.
WhatsNew.1227.zh-Hans: 视频可设置为点击后播放，网站可使用自定义的默认缩放比例。

WhatsNew.1228.en: A double-click on a pinned tab takes it back to the page it was pinned at.
WhatsNew.1228.zh-Hans: 双击固定标签页可返回最初固定的页面。

WhatsNew.1229.en: Hold a back or forward swipe to pick a page from history.
WhatsNew.1229.zh-Hans: 向后或向前滑动后按住，可从历史记录中选择页面。

WhatsNew.1230.en: Scrolling asks far less of the window, and a tab still loading no longer keeps the Mac busy.
WhatsNew.1230.zh-Hans: 降低滚动时的窗口开销，正在加载的标签页也不再让 Mac 持续忙碌。

WhatsNew.1231.en: Where links go, peeking at a link with a shift-click, and flicking the floating video to a corner are now on.
WhatsNew.1231.zh-Hans: 默认开启链接地址显示、Shift 单击预览链接和滑动画中画窗口贴边。

WhatsNew.1232.en: Tab managers and other extensions see every tab, in every window.
WhatsNew.1232.zh-Hans: 标签页管理器等扩展可查看所有窗口中的标签页。

WhatsNew.1233.en: Window › Move & Resize and the Mac's tiling work with SearcheXtra's window.
WhatsNew.1233.zh-Hans: 支持“窗口 › 移动与调整大小”和 Mac 的窗口平铺功能。

WhatsNew.1234.en: ⌘K always opens the list of your tabs, whatever the page.
WhatsNew.1234.zh-Hans: 无论当前页面是什么，⌘K 都会打开标签页列表。

WhatsNew.1235.en: ⌘← and ⌘→ go back and forward again.
WhatsNew.1235.zh-Hans: 恢复 ⌘← 和 ⌘→ 后退、前进功能。

WhatsNew.1236.en: Links from Notion and other apps bring SearcheXtra to the front.
WhatsNew.1236.zh-Hans: 从 Notion 等应用打开链接时，SearcheXtra 会切换到前台。

WhatsNew.1237.en: Addresses a dev server prints, like 0.0.0.0:3000, open.
WhatsNew.1237.zh-Hans: 支持打开开发服务器输出的地址，如 0.0.0.0:3000。

WhatsNew.1238.en: The tabs you had at quit are the ones that come back.
WhatsNew.1238.zh-Hans: 重启后恢复退出时的标签页。

WhatsNew.1239.en: The × closes a tab in the tab bar folded away with ⌘S.
WhatsNew.1239.zh-Hans: 修复用 ⌘S 收起标签栏后，× 按钮关闭标签页的问题。

WhatsNew.1240.en: 1Password, Bitwarden, NordPass, Passbolt, iCloud Passwords and the Claude extension each get their fixes.
WhatsNew.1240.zh-Hans: 修复 1Password、Bitwarden、NordPass、Passbolt、iCloud 密码和 Claude 扩展的相关问题。

WhatsNew.1243.zh-Hans: 安全性和鼠标滚轮改进。

WhatsNew.1244.en: Copying a saved password asks for Touch ID.
WhatsNew.1244.zh-Hans: 复制已保存密码时要求触控 ID 验证。

WhatsNew.1245.en: A mouse wheel scrolls smoothly again on x.com and pages like it.
WhatsNew.1245.zh-Hans: 恢复 x.com 等页面上的流畅滚轮滚动。

WhatsNew.1246.zh-Hans: 加快历史记录面板的打开速度。

WhatsNew.1247.en: Music keeps playing when you switch spaces.
WhatsNew.1247.zh-Hans: 切换空间时音乐继续播放。

WhatsNew.1248.zh-Hans: 弹出窗口需要用户点击才能打开。

WhatsNew.1249.en: The holes found in this week's reviews: an extension could read files outside its own folder, and a page or an ad could open another app without asking.
WhatsNew.1249.zh-Hans: 修复本周审查发现的漏洞：扩展可读取自身目录以外的文件，网页或广告可未经确认打开其他应用。

WhatsNew.1250.en: Bitwarden signs in to a self-hosted server, and extension popups hear what changes while they're open.
WhatsNew.1250.zh-Hans: 支持 Bitwarden 登录自托管服务器，扩展弹出窗口可在打开期间接收状态变化。

WhatsNew.1251.en: A link from Mail brings SearcheXtra to the front, and a full-screen video no longer goes black.
WhatsNew.1251.zh-Hans: 邮件中的链接会让 SearcheXtra 切换到前台，修复全屏视频黑屏问题。

WhatsNew.1252.en: Your extensions may each ask once more for their permissions at their next update.
WhatsNew.1252.zh-Hans: 扩展下次更新时，可能会再次请求权限确认。

WhatsNew.1254.zh-Hans: 通行密钥、密码管理器及 Google 兼容性改进。

WhatsNew.1255.en: A site's passkey button brings up the Mac's own passkey sheet: Touch ID, your iPhone, a security key.
WhatsNew.1255.zh-Hans: 网站的通行密钥按钮可调起 Mac 的系统面板，支持触控 ID、iPhone 和安全密钥。

WhatsNew.1256.en: SearcheXtra can be the Mac's default browser.
WhatsNew.1256.zh-Hans: SearcheXtra 可设为 Mac 的默认浏览器。

WhatsNew.1257.en: Each off until you turn it on in Settings: a bookmarks bar, a peek at a link with a shift-click, the video that follows you to another app, pages at 120 Hz, and where a link goes.
WhatsNew.1257.zh-Hans: 新增书签栏、Shift 单击预览链接、切换应用时自动画中画、120 Hz 页面刷新和链接地址显示，可在设置中开启。

WhatsNew.1258.en: Mute a tab, share a page, copy a link as Markdown, the mouse's back and forward buttons, and spaces in the bar across the top.
WhatsNew.1258.zh-Hans: 支持标签页静音、共享页面、复制 Markdown 链接、鼠标前进后退按钮，以及在顶部标签栏中显示空间。

WhatsNew.1259.en: Faster to open, and new tabs in about 10 ms.
WhatsNew.1259.zh-Hans: 加快启动速度，新建标签页约需 10 毫秒。

WhatsNew.1260.en: Pages see nothing of SearcheXtra that Safari doesn't show them, and a saved password is offered only on its own site.
WhatsNew.1260.zh-Hans: 网页能读取的浏览器信息与 Safari 保持一致，已保存密码仅在对应网站上提供。

WhatsNew.1261.zh-Hans: 改进 1Password、Bitwarden 和 Proton Pass 的兼容性。

WhatsNew.1262.en: If passkeys still fail after the update, restart your Mac once.
WhatsNew.1262.zh-Hans: 更新后若通行密钥仍无法使用，请重启 Mac。

WhatsNew.1264.en: The first update, made of a day of your replies and pull requests.
WhatsNew.1264.zh-Hans: 首次更新，根据一天内收到的反馈和拉取请求改进。

WhatsNew.1265.en: Each off until you turn it on in Settings: Spaces, a sidebar that hides until the pointer reaches the edge, and the search engine of your choice.
WhatsNew.1265.zh-Hans: 新增空间、指针移至边缘才显示的侧边栏和自选搜索引擎，可在设置中启用。

WhatsNew.1266.en: ⌘S folds the sidebar away, a middle-click closes a tab, a tab can be renamed, and the Web Inspector is in the View menu.
WhatsNew.1266.zh-Hans: ⌘S 可收起侧边栏，中键可关闭标签页，支持重命名标签页，并在“显示”菜单中加入网页检查器。

WhatsNew.1267.zh-Hans: 恢复 macOS 14 上的启动支持。

WhatsNew.1268.en: Signing in to Google no longer reloads the page over and over with iCloud Passwords installed.
WhatsNew.1268.zh-Hans: 修复安装 iCloud 密码扩展后，登录 Google 时页面反复重载的问题。

WhatsNew.1269.en: ⌘1–⌘9 on every keyboard layout, Tab between a form's fields, dragging tabs, a double-click along the top to fill the screen, and the Mac's beep while typing.
WhatsNew.1269.zh-Hans: 修复不同键盘布局下的 ⌘1–⌘9、表单 Tab 切换、拖动标签页、双击顶部填满屏幕，以及输入时的系统提示音问题。

WhatsNew.1271.en: The first version. A browser for the Mac with nothing in the way.
WhatsNew.1271.zh-Hans: 首个版本。为 Mac 打造的简洁浏览器。

WhatsNew.1272.en: Tabs in a row or down the side, pinned tabs that keep their place, and one field for addresses and searches.
WhatsNew.1272.zh-Hans: 标签页可横排或竖排，固定标签页保留位置，一个输入框同时用于网址和搜索。

WhatsNew.1273.en: Ads blocked before they load; passwords and passkeys in your keychain.
WhatsNew.1273.zh-Hans: 加载前拦截广告，密码和通行密钥保存在钥匙串中。

WhatsNew.1274.en: Anything on a page can be hidden; articles open in a reading mode and videos float.
WhatsNew.1274.zh-Hans: 可隐藏网页元素，文章支持阅读模式，视频支持画中画。

WhatsNew.1275.en: Chrome extensions from the Chrome Web Store, on macOS 15.4 or later.
WhatsNew.1275.zh-Hans: 在 macOS 15.4 或更新版本上支持 Chrome 应用商店扩展。

WhatsNew.1276.en: Tabs you haven't looked at for half an hour sleep and give their memory back.
WhatsNew.1276.zh-Hans: 半小时未查看的标签页会休眠并释放内存。

WhatsNew.1277.en: It runs on the engine already in macOS and weighs 2.9 MB.
WhatsNew.1277.zh-Hans: 使用 macOS 内置引擎，体积仅 2.9 MB。

WhatsNew.1279.en: From earlier versions, in case you missed them

ImportPanel.1308.en: macOS didn't hand over {0}'s key — allow it and try again
ImportPanel.1308.zh-Hans: macOS 未提供 {0} 的密钥，请允许访问后重试

ImportPanel.1309.en: {0} has a primary password: export your passwords from it and bring in the CSV file
ImportPanel.1309.zh-Hans: {0} 设置了主密码，请先导出密码，再导入 CSV 文件

ImportPanel.1311.en: Couldn't read all of {0}'s bookmarks: what came from it before was kept, {1} new
ImportPanel.1311.zh-Hans: 无法读取 {0} 的全部书签；此前导入的已保留，新增 {1} 个

ImportPanel.1314.zh-Hans: 新增 {0} 个书签，{1} 个已存在

ImportPanel.1318.en: Arc's spaces and pins were all here already
ImportPanel.1318.zh-Hans: Arc 的空间和固定标签页已全部导入过

language.detail.en: Choose the language for windows, menus and settings. Restart SearcheXtra to apply changes.
language.detail.zh-Hans: 选择窗口、菜单和设置的显示语言。更改后需重新启动 SearcheXtra。

language.restartDetail.en: The selected language takes effect after restarting SearcheXtra.
language.restartDetail.zh-Hans: 重新启动 SearcheXtra 后，所选语言会应用到所有窗口和菜单。

startPage.detail.en: Open this website in fresh windows. New tabs are blank unless a new-tab extension is configured. Restored sessions keep their pages; private tabs stay blank.
startPage.detail.zh-Hans: 新窗口打开此网址。未设置新标签页扩展时，新建标签页为空白页。恢复会话时保留原有页面，无痕标签页仍为空白页。

startPage.placeholder.en: Website address (blank for an empty page)
startPage.placeholder.zh-Hans: 输入网址，留空使用空白页

startPage.invalid.en: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS website, such as example.com.
startPage.invalid.zh-Hans: 请输入有效的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 网址，例如 example.com。

release100.headline.en: SearcheXtra is based on Search, developed by Office Commun. It provides the following features:
release100.headline.zh-Hans: SearcheXtra 是基于 Office Commun 开发的 Search 修改。提供以下功能：

release100.language1.en: English and Simplified Chinese cover menus, settings and descriptions, dialogs and action messages.
release100.language1.zh-Hans: 提供英文和简体中文，覆盖菜单、设置项及说明、弹窗和操作提示。

release100.language2.en: Choose Follow System, English or Simplified Chinese in Settings → General → Language. Restart to apply the change.
release100.language2.zh-Hans: 在“设置 → 通用 → 界面语言”中选择“跟随系统”“English”或“简体中文”，重新启动后生效。

release100.language3.en: The interface follows the system language by default and uses English for unsupported languages.
release100.language3.zh-Hans: 默认跟随系统语言；不支持的系统语言使用英文。

release100.start1.en: Save a website in Settings → General → Start Page. New windows open that page; new tabs are blank by default.
release100.start1.zh-Hans: 在“设置 → 通用 → 起始页面”中保存网址，新窗口会打开该页面；新建标签页默认保持空白。

release100.start2.en: Choose Use Blank Page to restore the default. Changes take effect immediately.
release100.start2.zh-Hans: 点击“使用空白页”可恢复默认，设置立即生效。

release100.start3.en: Restored sessions keep their original pages; private tabs still use a blank page.
release100.start3.zh-Hans: 恢复会话时保留原有页面；无痕标签页仍使用空白页。

extensions.updateFailed.en: Could not check or install the update. Try again.
extensions.updateFailed.zh-Hans: 检查或安装更新失败，请重试。

site.cleared.en: Site data cleared. Reload to apply.
site.cleared.zh-Hans: 网站数据已清除，刷新页面后生效。

site.reload.en: Reload the page to apply permission changes.
site.reload.zh-Hans: 刷新页面以应用权限修改。

site.cameraMicrophone.zh-Hans: 同时使用摄像头和麦克风

history.empty.zh-Hans: 没有最近关闭的标签页

upstream.link.foreground.en: Open Link in New Tab and Go to It
upstream.link.foreground.zh-Hans: 在新标签页中打开链接并切换

upstream.extension.alreadyLoaded.en: Already installed. Press Reload to take its changes
upstream.extension.alreadyLoaded.zh-Hans: 此扩展已安装。点击重新加载以应用目录中的修改。

upstream.extension.sourceMoved.en: {0} wasn't reloaded — its folder now leads somewhere else
upstream.extension.sourceMoved.zh-Hans: 未重新加载 {0}：扩展目录已指向其他位置。

updates.github.detail.en: Download the latest SearcheXtra release and replace the application
updates.github.detail.zh-Hans: 下载最新版 SearcheXtra 并替换应用
